world.description: A terraced Lisbon hillside at golden hour, walkable end to end: pastel townhouses with shutters, cornices and azulejo bands, cobbled streets and stairs up to a castle among cypresses, a church, a tram line, and a quay with boats under a red suspension bridge.

player-car.description: Drivable car parked in the Praca do Comercio square.
player-car.name: Your car

intent.text: golden hour, readable midtones, plum shadows, coral-peach sky

beach-umbrella.description: A detailed beach umbrella with a gently domed striped canopy, tilted wooden pole, radial underside ribs, sand mound, and a fringed beach towel in a coordinated palette.

stripeColor.description: alternating canopy and towel stripe color

castle-gate.description: A detailed medieval stone castle gatehouse with twin crenellated towers, a deep arched passage, iron portcullis, battlements, wall walk, arrow slits, and rear-facing architectural detail.

fountain.description: Tiered stone fountain with a round basin, pedestal, upper bowl and shimmering water.

hero-fountain.description: Three-tier sandstone fountain, 3.4 m wide x 3 m tall: octagonal basin R1.7 h0.82 with moulded rim and 8 carved panels; fluted column r0.22 to y1.3; scalloped bowl 1 r1.0 (y1.25-1.7); stem r0.14; bowl 2 r0.62 (y1.95-2.3); stem r0.08; pinecone finial to y3.0; blue emissive translucent water in each bowl plus thin falling sheets.

laundry-line.description: Washing line strung across a lane along X with hanging coloured laundry (sheets, shirts, towels). Rope at local y=1.0, laundry hangs below to y=0.

lisbon-church.description: Baroque Lisbon waterfront church: cream plastered nave with pedimented ochre-trimmed facade, arched door and windows, terracotta gabled roof, apse, side annex, and a square corner bell tower with arched belfry, clock, octagonal copper-grey cupola, lantern and iron cross.

lisbon-houses2.description: Individual varied Lisbon townhouses along one street (param street 0-11): different widths, heights, colours, roofs, windows, shutters, balconies, alley gaps

lisbon-kerbs.description: Street edging for an east-west street: granite kerb stones, a gutter channel and limestone calcada pavements on both sides, optionally skipping a central plaza. Centred on the street centre line, base y=0. A tile (tile1 > tile0) keeps what lies in local x [tile0, tile1) and is centred on that range; extent is its width plus overhang (for streaming).

lisbon-retaining.description: Rubble limestone/basalt retaining wall (or quay face) built from irregular coursed blocks, a limestone lip, optional pilasters and trailing bougainvillea/ivy. Front faces +Z, base at y=0, centred in x/z. collide=false for visual-only faces. A tile (tile1 > tile0) keeps what lies in local x [tile0, tile1) and is centred on that range; extent is its width plus overhang (for streaming).

lisbon-roads2.description: Switchback cobbled streets with pavements, quay with wall, plazas, tram rails, lamps and stairways; part 0 and 1 split the streets

lisbon-row.description: A terrace row of individual Lisbon townhouses along X (front faces +Z): plaster facades, windows, doors, balconies, cornices, terracotta roofs. Gaps for stairs and plazas. Ground level is at local y=foundation.

lisbon-row3.description: Terrace of Lisbon townhouses: tinted plaster facades, limestone plinth and cornice, painted shutters, glazed windows (some lit), iron balconies, terracotta roof-tile roofs, azulejo-clad fronts. Row spans x -88..88, front faces +z, centred on its own origin; local y=0 is 2 m below the street.

lisbon-row4.description: Lisbon terrace of detailed townhouses (or a single house) with finishes: plinth, pastel/azulejo facades, quoins, string courses, cornice, surrounds, shutters, iron balconies, doors, hip/gable terracotta roofs, chimneys, dormers. Front +z, row centred, 176 m wide, street level y=2.15. A tile (tile1 > tile0) keeps the houses whose centre x is in [tile0, tile1) and is centred on that range; extent is its width plus overhang (for streaming).

lisbon-setts.description: Cobbled road surface overlay for an east-west street: mottled granite/limestone setts with small relief, a worn lighter centre line, and optional tram rails; skips a central plaza. Base y=0. A tile (tile1 > tile0) keeps what lies in local x [tile0, tile1) and is centred on that range; extent is its width plus overhang (for streaming).

lisbon-stairs.description: Stone stairway descending toward +Z with side walls. Pre-build top at y=rise; place at world y = lowerLevel - 0.3 and z centre of the run.

lisbon-stairs3.description: Escadinhas: limestone stepped stair rising to the NORTH (-z) by 6.5 m over 7.5 m, centred on its origin, with low limestone side walls and painted-iron handrails with posts. Base y=0 is 0.3 m below the low end.

lisbon-street.description: Cobbled street strip along X (width along Z) with limestone pavements, optional tram rails and sleepers. Base y=0 is the street surface.

lisbon-street3.description: Street along X, 3.78 m each side of centre: granite-sett cobble or asphalt carriageway, granite kerbs, calcada portuguesa limestone/basalt pavements, optional tram rails at railZ, manholes. Local y=0 is the street level. A tile (tile1 > tile0) keeps what lies in local x [tile0, tile1) and is centred on that range; extent is its width plus overhang (for streaming).

lisbon-terrain2.description: Rolling Lisbon hills, river trench, quays; part 0 near detailed tile with collider, part 1 far horizon tile

lisbon-terrain3.description: Lisbon terraced hillside terrain with trimesh collider; far part sunk under the near part

lisbon-tram.description: Yellow Lisbon tram (remodelado) 9 m long along Z, 2.4 m wide: yellow body with cream band, dark windows, roof pantograph, bumpers, wheels.

lisbon-tram3.description: Lisbon yellow tram along X, symmetric ends: yellow painted body with cream stripe, glazed band, dark roof, pantograph, bogies with wheels, lamps.

red-bridge2.description: Red suspension bridge along Z with two towers, cables, hangers, deck and approach ramp. Deck top at local y=8; length 107 plus ramp

red-bridge3.description: Large red suspension bridge along X (like Lisbon's 25 de Abril): two towers, main cables with hangers, truss deck. Pre-build deck top at y=28, tower base at y=0.

red-bridge4.description: Red suspension bridge along X: twin H-towers with cross braces, main cables, hangers, truss deck with railings and approach piers.

red-bridge5.description: Detailed red suspension bridge along X: bevelled towers with portal beams and bracing, stiffening truss with diagonals and verticals, cross-beams, main and side-span cables with hangers, road with lane marks, rails, lamps, piers and anchorages.

world.name: Lisbon Hills

then.text: Welcome to the Lisbon hillside. Walk up the market street, ride the yellow trams, or take the sports car in the square.

source.prompt: weathered asphalt road surface with fine grey aggregate, faint hairline cracks and a few darker patches
